title: Sailaway Clear Lake Charters
specs: Sailing in Kemah, Clear Lake and Galveston Bay
blurb: Sailaway Cat offers flexible sailing charters ranging from two to four hours, customizable to guest preferences. Guests can choose to be actively involved in sailing or relax and enjoy the scenery. Charters include daily cruises, romantic sunset sails, private parties, weddings, and corporate outings on Galveston Bay.
highlights: Sailing in Kemah, Clear Lake and Galveston Bay

quotes.text: We had a wonderful time on Captain Matt's catamaran! We were a group of 6, which was perfect...we all had plenty of room. He was very open to our questions and allowed us to help, as we are hoping to own a cat in the future. We were able to sail in the bay and cruise on the lake. Overall, it was a 5 star experience!

We chartered Captain Matt's catamaran boat and had a marvelous time. The boat was spotless and there was an obvious pride of ownership. As experienced boaters ourselves, we appreciated the mandatory safety presentation.
